description.zh: 经典乒乓球对战 AI。用鼠标、触屏或键盘上下移动球拍，回球角度随接触点变化，打在拍边缘会拉出刁钻斜线。每 2 分换发球，对拉越久球速越快，先得 7 分者胜，简单 / 普通 / 困难三档难度任你挑战！
description.en: Classic Pong against the AI. Move your paddle with mouse, touch or keyboard — the return angle follows the contact point, so edge hits pull sharp diagonals. Serve switches every two points and the ball speeds up the longer the rally lasts; the first to 7 points wins, with Easy / Normal / Hard to choose from!

controls.zh: 鼠标 / 触摸上下拖动，或 W/S、↑/↓ 移动球拍，Esc / P 暂停
controls.en: Drag up/down with mouse / touch or use W/S, ↑/↓ to move the paddle, Esc / P to pause
